interview.secured: It seems to mean I finished today's task for the challenge, since after I logged my 10 pages the app showed 'Day secured' and my profile now says 1 day secured with 0 verified.
interview.freeze: I don't actually know, because the app never explained what a freeze is anywhere I saw.
interview.selfReported: I'm guessing it means I just said I did the task myself without proof, which would fit my profile showing 0 verified, but the app never spelled that out.
interview.tomorrow: 7 - 10 pages a day feels doable and I don't want to lose my 1-day streak, though I'm still not sure what 'verified' needs from me.

goals.text: Pick the easiest-looking challenge and finish the first task.

device: GRIIT iPhone 16. Persona phone size was recorded and not applied, because this is the simulator that has the app installed.
